name: mirage
text: You're right. The Odds API's 21 keys are all at about 271-286 of 500 used. The cause was a day-pacing rule that let each key spend only its share of the month, so the engine moved to the next key after each share and every key ended up equally used. I've removed that pacing for The Odds API. It now uses key 1 down to a 20-credit reserve, then key 2, and so on in your order. The change is in the code and the tests are running. It reaches the engine at the next release or engine restart. ParlayAPI still paces its keys, but it already uses the biggest paid key first (dbe1d3, 309k of 1M used) and the free keys are nearly spent. If you meant a different API, tell me which.
